comment: CCSDS telemetry, Reed-Solomon only: BPSK, each transfer frame of `depth` interleaved RS(255,223) codewords behind
the 32-bit attached sync marker, the frame randomized (restarting at each marker).
Timing and carrier from block estimators (the carrier by the 2nd power:
the delimiter puts the 180 degree ambiguity right by the marker's sense).
The Reed-Solomon symbols are in the dual basis, as the standard sends them (`rs`:
rs/ccsds_255_223 for a spacecraft that uses the conventional one). Out come the 223 x depth bytes of each frame
the Reed-Solomon code: rs/ccsds_255_223_dual (the standard's dual basis) or rs/ccsds_255_223 (conventional)

requires.comment: any symbol rate: given, or measured

message.comment: a transfer frame: the RS data of its depth codewords
